blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A former law school dean’s decision to beg off from his presentation as a witness in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial is correct, Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon said. He explains that this is because what should be addressed are numbers concerning the unexplained wealth issue, and not legalities. Ridon in a statement on Thursday said that Duterte’s lawyers should present witnesses who will be able to dispute the figures brought by the prosecution before the Senate Impeachment Court.
